digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow gate dispatch and container staging
propositions: Three defensive exception-handling arms in gate_dispatch.py and container_stage.py that decide abort-vs-degrade for LLM failures have no reachable test coverage

Plan-review mid-run arm in produce_plan_review_verdict and _run_code_review_gate must handle both LLMUnavailableError and LLMInputRejectedError by degrading to INDETERMINATE verdict with gate_error sidecar
Container warm-call abort in _run_container must raise (abort, no fan-out) when either LLMUnavailableError or LLMInputRejectedError occurs; non-systemic failures degrade to direct fan-out
Batch-runner exceptions propagate raw out of run_workflow through _run_batch's unguarded runner.run call, making plan-review and container arms reachable in production
Code-review mid-run arm is a defensive seam contract today because SystemicDiscoveryError is absorbed upstream by discovery.execute_stage, with no in-tree raw raiser found
